title: Pure Gigo
summary: The Gigo storyline series chronicles the tragic and powerful journey of Gagagigo through all of his WATER Reptile forms—from Gigobyte and Gagagigo to Giga Gagagigo and Gogiga Gagagigo. Supported by his lore partner Eria the Water Charmer and A Legendary Ocean (which reduces their Levels so high-ATK beatsticks can be summoned with fewer or no Tributes), the deck swarms the field with Rescue Rabbit and Jigabyte to field 2950 ATK Rank 4 Gagagigo the Risen and control the board with Number 4: Stealth Kragen.

allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Level 4 Gagagigo or Level 1 Gigobyte directly from the Deck.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Level 4 Gagagigo or Level 1 Gigobyte directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.A Legendary Ocean: Treated as 'Umi'; boosts all WATER Gigo monsters by 200 ATK/DEF and reduces their Levels in hand and field by 1 so Level 5 Giga Gagagigo requires 0 Tributes!
allow.Warrior of Atlantis: Discards itself to add A Legendary Ocean from the Deck to the hand and is a Level 4 WATER monster for Rank 4 plays.
allow.Eria the Water Charmer: Level 3 WATER Spellcaster (Gagagigo's lore partner!) whose Spellcaster Type on field enables Jigabyte to Special Summon itself from the hand and send both to the GY to summon Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte directly from the Deck!
allow.Number 4: Stealth Kragen: Rank 4 WATER Aqua boss that turns all monsters on the field into WATER, destroys a WATER monster on either player's turn to burn for half its ATK, and floats into Stealth Kragen Spawns when destroyed.
allow.Stealth Kragen Spawn: Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz summoned by Number 4: Stealth Kragen that destroys a WATER monster on either player's turn and floats back into Number 4: Stealth Kragen.
allow.Eria the Water Charmer, Gentle: Link-2 WATER Spellcaster depicting Gagagigo/Jigabyte that revives a WATER monster from the opponent's GY, enables Jigabyte's Special Summon, and searches a 1500 DEF WATER monster when destroyed.
allow.Mistar Boy: Link-2 WATER monster that boosts all WATER Gigo monsters by 500 ATK.
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 stall boss made with two Level 4 WATER monsters that switches all monsters to Defense Position and negates their activated effects.

main: Gagagigo
Level 4 WATER Reptile Normal Monster (1850 ATK / 1000 DEF) summoned via Rescue Rabbit and Unexpected Dai to make Gagagigo the Risen and Stealth Kragen.
Jigabyte

Level 4 WATER Reptile Effect Monster (1500 ATK / 200 DEF) that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Spellcaster (Eria), and summons another 1500 ATK / 200 DEF monster when destroyed.
Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte

Level 5 WATER Reptile boss (2000 ATK / 200 DEF) that can be Special Summoned directly from your hand OR Deck by sending 1 Spellcaster (Eria) and 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster (Gagagigo/Jigabyte) you control to the GY, ripping 1 random card from the opponent's hand!
Giga Gagagigo
Level 5 WATER Reptile Normal Monster (2450 ATK / 1500 DEF) that becomes a Level 4 2650 ATK monster in hand/field with 0 Tributes while A Legendary Ocean is active!
Gogiga Gagagigo
Level 8 WATER Reptile Normal Monster (2950 ATK / 2800 DEF) that becomes a 1-Tribute 3150 ATK monster under A Legendary Ocean.
Gigobyte
Level 1 WATER Reptile Normal Monster (350 ATK / 300 DEF) representing baby Gagagigo, summonable via Unexpected Dai to fuel Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte.
Eria the Water Charmer
WATER Spellcaster partner of Gagagigo that turns on both Jigabyte's hand Special Summon and Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte's Deck summon.
Rescue Rabbit
Summons 2 Gagagigo from the Deck; adding Jigabyte from hand immediately assembles the 3 Level 4 monsters required for Gagagigo the Risen!
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Gagagigo or Gigobyte directly from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Warrior of Atlantis
Discards itself to search A Legendary Ocean, or Normal Summons as a Level 4 WATER body for Rank 4 plays.
A Legendary Ocean
Boosts all WATER Gigo monsters by 200 ATK/DEF and reduces their Levels by 1 so Level 5 Giga Gagagigo is a Level 4 2650 ATK Normal Summon.
extra: Signature Rank 4 WATER Reptile Xyz boss (3 Level 4 monsters) with 2950 ATK / 2800 DEF, easily summoned using 2 Gagagigo (from Rescue Rabbit) + Jigabyte or Unexpected Dai.
Rank 4 WATER Aqua boss that turns all monsters into WATER, pops a WATER monster once per turn on either turn to burn, and floats into Stealth Kragen Spawns.
Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz summoned by Number 4: Stealth Kragen that pops a WATER monster and floats back into Stealth Kragen.

Link-2 WATER Spellcaster made with any WATER Gigo monster; provides a face-up Spellcaster on field so Jigabyte can Special Summon itself from hand and Tribute both for Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte from the Deck!
Link-2 WATER monster that boosts Gagagigo the Risen to 3450 ATK.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 stall boss that switches monsters to Defense Position and negates their activated effects.
